tasks.short: Testify at inquests, hearings, and trials.

steps.what: Read the case before the coroner will testify.

tasks.design: The coroner reads the case and testifies at the inquest, the hearing, or the trial. A note records which hearing took place. No statement is drafted for them to read out, and the testimony is not recorded by this office.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questions in court are not known in advance, and the answer has to be the coroner's own.
tasks.enabler_now: The date of a hearing can be noted afterwards. The testimony itself cannot be prepared as a script.
tasks.still_hard: A prepared answer that the coroner did not mean, given under oath, is a serious harm.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner testifies from the case they handled. A draft is not their evidence.
tasks.altitude: Testifying stays with the coroner. The note only records which hearing took place, after they have spoken.

reach.task: Hear testimony the coroner gives in person
reach.learn: The coroner spoke from the case they handled

evidence.claim: A hearing date can be noted after the coroner has testified. The testimony is not drafted for them.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a hearing is set and ends when the coroner has testified and the hearing is noted. Preparing the case findings is a separate task. Testimony is not recorded here.
The fields are case id, hearing type, and date. The coroner produces the fact of having testified by being there. No text of the evidence is generated.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. The note of the hearing is a small remainder.
Upkeep is zero beyond the hearing-type labels already on the file, so the added upkeep is a check of those labels.
unknowns: Whether this office is allowed to keep a note of the questions asked.
Who tells the coroner which hearing they must attend.
research_questions: May this office keep a note of the questions asked?
Who tells the coroner which hearing to attend?

already_counted.description: Testifying at inquests and hearings stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Check the hearing-type labels already on the file

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the hearing note is already kept by the court, the low end is the reading and the testimony, which stay. No statement is written for the coroner. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with health and enforcement agencies.

steps.what: Review the note of those activities.
Send the accepted note to the agencies.

tasks.design: The coroner confers with public health and with enforcement, and coordinates what the offices will do. The note of those activities is sent only after they review it. The meeting is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: What the offices will do is agreed in the conversation, and it changes with the case.
tasks.enabler_now: A note the coroner has reviewed can be sent without retyping it into a message.
tasks.still_hard: An activity the coroner did not agree can commit another office, or disclose a fact that should wait.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner makes the agreement in the meeting. The note reports that agreement.
tasks.altitude: The conferences and the coordination stay with the coroner. The agencies receive only the note they reviewed.

reach.task: Act on activities the coroner coordinated
reach.learn: The coroner agreed the activities in the meeting

evidence.claim: A note of activities the coroner already agreed can be sent after they review it. The meeting is not recorded.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a conference is needed and ends when the reviewed note has been sent. The investigation decisions stay in their own tasks.
The fields are case id, the offices present, and the activities the coroner stated. The coroner produces them from the meeting. An activity they did not state is not added.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the conferences. Only the sending of a reviewed note is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the agency addresses current.
unknowns: Which activities need both health and enforcement in the room.
Whether the note may name a living person.
research_questions: Which activities need both offices in the room?
May the note name a living person?

already_counted.description: Conferring with public health officials stays in full inside that step

approvals.approved_version: note of interdepartmental activities the coroner reviewed after the conference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the offices already write their own note, the low end is the conferences and the coordination, which stay, and the send is not needed. The meeting is not recorded either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: File documentation for handling of the remains.

tasks.design: The coroner collects the wills and burial instructions and checks which documentation the investigation and the remains need. The file stores the set they reviewed. It does not decide that a will is valid.
tasks.previous_blocker: Papers are in the house, with a relative, or at a firm, and only the coroner can say which ones the case needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Documents the coroner has collected and reviewed can be filed without copying each page by hand.
tasks.still_hard: A will treated as valid, or a burial instruction missed, changes the handling of the remains.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner collects the papers and checks what the case needs. The file holds that set.
tasks.altitude: Collecting and checking the documents stay with the coroner. The file holds the documentation they reviewed, and it does not say a will is valid.

reach.task: Follow burial instructions the coroner collected
reach.learn: The coroner checked that the papers belonged to this death

evidence.claim: Documents the coroner has collected can be filed after they review them. Validity of a will is not decided by the file.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when papers must be found and ends when the reviewed set is on the file. Probate, if any, stays outside it.
The fields are case id, document type, and where it was collected. The coroner produces them by collecting. The text of a will is not summarised.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on collecting and checking. Only the filing of a reviewed set is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the document-type labels, such as will and burial instruction, stable.
unknowns: Whether a will must go to a notary before the remains are released.
Which burial instructions this office is allowed to follow.
research_questions: Must a will go to a notary before the remains are released?
Which burial instructions may this office follow?

already_counted.description: Collecting wills and burial instructions stays in full inside that step

approvals.approved_version: wills and burial instructions the coroner reviewed after collecting them

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the papers are already in the file from the family, the low end is the check that they are the right ones, which stays. The text of a will is not summarised either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record care arrangements for minor children.

steps.what: Find whether minor children are affected.
Speak with the person about the arrangements.
Review details of the disposition and arrangements.

tasks.design: The coroner finds whether minor children are affected, makes the care arrangements, and speaks with the person who will provide the care. The file records the disposition only after they review the details. No tool chooses a carer or a child.
tasks.previous_blocker: Who should care for a child is a decision on the family and on national rules, made with the people involved.
tasks.enabler_now: A disposition the coroner has already made can be recorded without a second writing.
tasks.still_hard: The wrong carer, or a record that invents an arrangement, puts a child at risk.
tasks.human_edge: The coroner makes the arrangement and speaks to the carer. The file records that.
tasks.altitude: The care arrangements stay with the coroner. The record is the disposition they reviewed after speaking with the carer.

reach.task: Take on care the coroner arranged
reach.learn: The coroner spoke with them before the record was written

evidence.claim: A disposition of minor children can be recorded after the coroner has made the arrangements and spoken with the carer. A tool does not choose the care.

Assigning cause or manner of death, certifying a death, and arranging care for a child are determinations the coroner makes. A tool does not make them. National rules decide who may certify a death. EU data-protection rules cover medical details and living relatives. The file stores only what the coroner recorded, and interviews are not stored as audio.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a death may leave minor children and ends when the reviewed disposition is on the file. Child-protection proceedings, if any, stay outside it.
The fields are case id, whether children are affected, the carer the coroner named, and the arrangement they made. The coroner produces them. No child is matched to a carer.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on finding the children, making the arrangements, and speaking with the carer. Only the copy of a reviewed disposition is shorter.
Upkeep is keeping the care-arrangement labels the office is allowed to use.
unknowns: Who, under national rules, may arrange care for a minor child after a death.
Which details of a child may be stored on the death file.
research_questions: Who may arrange care for a minor child after a death?
Which details of a child may be stored on the death file?

already_counted.description: Making care arrangements stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the care-arrangement labels the office may use

approvals.approved_version: disposition and care arrangements the coroner reviewed after speaking with the carer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the arrangement is made entirely in conversation and the record is a few lines, the low end is finding the children, making the arrangements, and speaking with the carer, which stay. No tool chooses the care. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Testimony, conferences with other offices, and care for minor children stay with the coroner. Papers are collected and checked by them. A note is sent, and a disposition is recorded, only after they have reviewed it. No tool chooses a carer.
reach: A court hears testimony the coroner gives in person
A carer takes on care the coroner arranged and then recorded
skills_to_grow: Sending a conference note only after the meeting
Recording a child's care only after speaking with the carer
role.ambitious_version: Every care record follows an arrangement the coroner made, and every word of testimony is their own.
